listing.name: Conker's Bad Fur Day: Recompiled (sciaschi)
listing.summary: Explore Conker's Bad Fur Day: Recompiled (sciaschi) and follow the upstream project for requirements, downloads and setup.

steps.title: Start with your original game
steps.instruction: On first Play, choose your own US Conker’s Bad Fur Day ROM in big-endian .z64 format. The launcher extracts what it needs from that ROM; the published player does not require compiling the game.

steps.title: Keep your progress
steps.instruction: The default imported ROM, EEPROM saves, save states, achievements, settings and mods live in LocalAppData/ConkerRecompiled, outside Portcove backups. Declared crash.log and rt64_fb_log.txt diagnostics beside the executable, and the conker_data legacy/headless directory, are retained if present. Use an external copy for portable.txt mode, headless flags or customized storage. Save states remain build-sensitive.

presentation.manual_preparation: On first Play, choose your own US Conker’s Bad Fur Day ROM in big-endian .z64 format. Declared crash.log and rt64_fb_log.txt diagnostics beside the executable, and the conker_data legacy/headless directory, are retained if present.
